description.value: Bee Thai Cuisine is a family-owned Thai restaurant specializing in North Eastern Isan Thai cuisine, operating in Mission, BC since 2015. The menu spans traditional curries, stir-fries, and a bubble tea selection, made with recipes passed down through generations. Its reputation draws diners from across the Canada-US border, with at least one reviewer making a cross-border trip specifically for the food.
